corruption_fixture_method: twelve persisted object classes, each corrupted twice: one committed-byte flip and one single canonical-field mutation; both must fail closed
crash_point_coverage: every declared fault point is replayed and asserted for durable presence/absence, effect invocation count, reconciliation classification, replay policy, temporary-file detection, absence of a duplicate effect, and absence of a false COMPLETED state
ending_commit_note: The ending commit is the single intentional commit 'feat: implement shared paired runner effect substrate' created on this branch; its hash is reported in the terminal Milestone 2 response and cannot appear inside the object it commits.
known_limitations: Every measurement was taken under WSL2; this is not clean-host Linux qualification and no VERIFIED_INSTALLED_PATH status is claimed for any requirement.
fsync is claimed only as 'the flush was requested and the committed bytes were read back'; device write caches, virtualised block devices, and power loss were not tested.
The thirteen fault points are deterministic in-process simulations, not power cuts.

subprocess.Popen accepts a cwd string rather than a directory descriptor, so the final execve is not descriptor-anchored; the path is proven symlink-free component by component and re-verified with realpath immediately before the launch.

Child CPU time and peak RSS come from getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) deltas that aggregate every reaped child of the controller, so they are OBSERVED_BEST_EFFORT upper bounds rather than isolated per-process measurements.
A descendant that calls setsid leaves the reachable process group.
TEST-08 is closed for massive output only; long-duration coverage is bounded by the Milestone 1 60000 ms per-command timeout and belongs to Milestone 3.
TEST-03 is closed only at the provider-free shared-substrate boundary and is not proof of complete future A/B runners.
EVID-04 remains DESIGNED because Milestone 2 contains no policy engine; only the typed decision object is durably published.
EVID-05 and EVID-06 remain IMPLEMENTED because the experiment initial snapshot, the terminal manifest, and the real model/executable/transport identities do not exist yet.
Milestone 2 implements deterministic single-effect recovery only; full multi-session restart, checkpoints, and cumulative budgets are Milestone 3.
